children: announced at least 13 billion of digital infrastructure spending in Finland across 2027 and 2028, its largest single investment in Europe. The money covers data centers in Hamina, Kajaani, Muhos and Vaala, and Google projects an annual average 3.6 billion contribution to Finnish GDP during construction, supporting more than 37,000 jobs and 7,000 once operational. Alphabet shares were down 3.03% intraday.

Google signed a 22-year power purchase agreement with Fortum to fund the life extension of the Loviisa nuclear plant, which employs about 580 people and supplies 10% of Finland's electricity. A separate memorandum covers possible new reactors at the site. Add 629MW of new-to-grid onshore wind through Valorem and Suomen Hyotytuuli, and a 94MW battery near Kajaani running from late 2027.

title: Google Signs 22 Years of Nuclear to Power Finnish Data Centers
